status: observational input-table analysis; no model mechanism adopted

sample.population: base vocabulary IDs excluding tokenizer special IDs
sample.weighting: equal weight per vocabulary entry; not corpus frequency or contextual hidden states

limits: No physical or semantic distance is inferred between dimension labels.
Covariance does not establish causation, useful recurrence, or a connection rule.
These statistics precede the unchosen probabilistic positive/negative population encoder.
No whitening, rotation, dimension reduction, neuron remapping, or learned metric is proposed.
Vocabulary entries are not independent draws from a behavioral token stream; no independence-based confidence interval is claimed.
authority: D-08 pending-human; observational evidence under H-51, not a design contract

reproduction.method: Decode ordinary BF16 rows to float64 in2048-row blocks; accumulate sum(x) and sum(x.T@x); C=E[xx.T]-mean*mean.T; use eigvalsh(C) and all upper-triangle Pearson correlations.
reproduction.artifact_boundary: Full covariance and mean arrays remain in the SSD cache; compact statistics and the5120 eigenvalues are recorded here.

covariance_decomposition.null_boundary: The IID Gaussian sample benchmark is conditional, not a confidence calculation for dependent vocabulary entries.
